questions.question: Fill appropriate words in the blanks
Action Research is not a justification of one's teaching practices.
Drag the words into the correct boxes
Which of the following is not a step in the Action Research Process?
Which of the following is not related to the criticism of Action Research?
options: [C] There is lack of knowledge of the Methodology of Action Research
[D] Findings will have implications on classroom practices
questions.answer: [D] Findings will have implications on classroom practices

questions.question: Educational Action Research is - i) a research for the teachers ii) a research by the teachers iii) a research of the teachers
Main objective of Action Research is
Which of the following is not a characteristic of Action Research?
options: [B] Finding solutions to practical problems faced by the teacher in the classroom
[D] Finding a scientific solution to the problem
questions.answer: [D] Finding a scientific solution to the problem

questions.question: Which of the following is not a problem of Action Research?
options: [A] Teachers do not opt for a research project and apply for research grant. What can I do?
[B] Students absorb information given by me, like a sponge. They never inquire about anything. What is lacking in my way of teaching?
[C] Students don't take interest in extra-curricular reading. What are their difficulties?
[D] In what way I can make teachers more accountable to their duties?
questions.answer: [A] Teachers do not opt for a research project and apply for research grant. What can I do?
